title: nwjl.2: C: add expiry field to slot claims and enforce expiry > now
description: Spec GCP-6.5 step 7: expiry > now check. struct lichen_slot_claim has no expiry field. Add u32 expiry_epoch to the claim struct, include in signature transcript, reject claims where expiry <= current epoch. Add test with expired claims.
close_reason: Already implemented by the COSE migration (audit close): the COSE payload includes CLAIM_KEY_EXPIRY (claim_encode_payload), and the receiver enforces expiry under a synced wall clock (coap_slot_coord.c: expiry gate at :423-427 — LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_EXPIRED, with the clock_valid/now!=0 fail-closed precondition per R-05-080). Nothing to add.
